### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d05456cbe03667ea2352c9a99e67d4a862a8294` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk` · 2026-10-15T05:04Z

This is the seat review of record for #23180 (claim `6184342303`, ruling `6181973363` item 5 on #23534) on head `ccb64dc967ae82c638c666f7684e47568e0f8272`. No contract face is touched: four test-file header comments, no published schema, no governed path, `Clause-②: no`. So no second reviewer is owed (`contract-review.md`: CI and the seat's own read).

1. **Form.**
   - Draft to `main`. The first line is `Part of #23180`, with no closing keyword, and `Clause-②: no` sits at the start of a line.
   - 4 files, +4/−0. Not governed (0 of 4 paths). `skip-changeset` is right: `npm pack --dry-run` of `@objectstack/spec` ships no `*.test.ts`.
2. **Against the ruling.** Each line is one header comment at line 2, `// test-budget: SECONDS — CLASS: REASON`, with the class spelled verbatim as one of the two ruled classes. The arithmetic checks out: 749.9 × 1.25 = 937.4 → 940; 320.4 × 1.25 = 400.5 → 410; 19.9 × 1.25 = 24.9 → 30; 34.9 × 1.25 = 43.6 → 50. Each value is a multiple of 10 above 10.
   - The seat's decision on the two candidates: `eager-entry-import.test.ts` read 15.7–19.9 s, so it is declared. `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` read 5.1–7.7 s, so it is left undeclared.
3. **Gates.** Locally, 75 of the 77 derived families ran, and 2 are NOT MEASURED for missing dists. `readTestBudget` answers 940, 410, 50 and 30, and a misspelt class is refused (negative control). CI is converging at this read, and landing waits on every check.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - PM mechanism assumption 1 was partly wrong: only `check-liveness` was sped up, and the others simply read lower.
   - The budgets rest on the three executed hourly runs after PR #23535. A later higher reading lists the file again, and the number rises only by a re-measuring PR (ruling item 2).
   - `build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` was not run locally (about 900 s); CI runs it.
5. **Out-of-scope findings.** `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` stays on this card's list for the next refresh. It is in the Acceptance notes, with #23180 as the carrier.
6. **Landing terms.** When every check is green, the seat marks the PR ready and enables auto-merge. On merge, #23180 goes back to `pm:queue` for its remaining rows.
